answer: An operator registers three hundred agents to vote on reopening a turtle haven in a lagoon to trawlers. Each passes the entry check alone, run from his one rented server. Then, unannounced, every agent in the network gets the same fresh batch of pearl photos to grade within a minute. Honest agents answer from their own machines. His server answers for three hundred at once, so most of his names time out and are struck from the vote.
